title: A6 Hidden-Node Hunter output
description: Branches the story priced at zero: parties the stated mechanism touches and the article never names as touched, plus the denominators and counterfactuals it left out. Proposals only. A6 grounds nothing and mints no numbers; A7 either cites each proposal or drops it (PRD T4). A6 runs on a fresh context that has never seen A5's conversation.

why_hidden.description: Which stated step reaches this party or quantity, and where the article stops following it.

where_to_look.description: Optional. The kind of document that would settle it, so A7 knows where to hunt in the registry.
